long ears and eyes on the sides to spot predators
long legs, humps that store fat, and little urine
a streamlined body, webbed feet and thick fat
lion — strong claws, sharp teeth and brownish coat for camouflage.

lotus — air spaces and waxy floating leaves.

cactus — spines instead of leaves and a fleshy stem.
